name: Glycerolipid synthesis and lipase-regulated triglyceride and phospholipid breakdown
rationale: Members cover PA/DAG/MAG/TAG synthesis plus regulated lipase-driven TAG and PC catabolism (incl. PDE3B antilipolysis), distinguishing it from lipid-droplet/adipocyte storage, PC-synthesis and lysophospholipid-hydrolysis neighbours.

qualifier: pyrimidine breakdown and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
name: Pyrimidine nucleotide catabolism and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members are nucleotide/deoxynucleotide and pyrimidine catabolism plus NUDT sanitization and thiopurine/ribavirin/abacavir metabolism, setting it apart from neighbours centred on purine/pyrimidine biosynthesis, salvage or nucleoside transport.

name: RAF-ERK cascade with negative feedback and ERK dephosphorylation
rationale: Members span RAF activation (incl. MRAS-SHOC2), MAPK mutants and RSK, plus ERK inactivation, dephosphorylation and negative feedback, which the RAS/GAP/SOS and oncogenic-RAF neighbours lack.

name: NAD(P)+ metabolism via nicotinate salvage
rationale: Members concern pyridine nucleotide salvage from nicotinate, NADP+ synthesis, NAD+ breakdown and transport, unlike the tryptophan de novo NAD, CoA and nucleotide-interconversion neighbours.

name: Epithelial migration and proliferation in wound healing
rationale: All members regulate keratinocyte/epithelial spreading, migration, proliferation or inflammation during wound repair, whereas neighbours focus on negative regulation of migration, adhesion and Rho/Rac or EGF/VEGF signalling.

name: Iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis and respiratory complex III assembly
rationale: Members cover [2Fe-2S]/[4Fe-4S] and cytosolic Fe-S assembly, Fe-S maturation of TCA enzymes and complex III assembly, separating it from heme/steroidogenic Fe-S neighbours (no complex III) and complex I/IV assembly neighbours (no Fe-S biogenesis).

qualifier: FRS, SHC and PI3K cascades of FGFR1, 2 and 4
name: FGFR1/2/4 downstream FRS, SHC and PI3K cascades
rationale: Members are adaptor-driven downstream cascades (FRS, SHC, PI3K, PLCG) of FGFR1, FGFR2 and FGFR4 plus betaKlotho binding, whereas neighbours centre on FGFR ligand binding/isoforms, FGFR3 or feedback regulation.

name: Glycosaminoglycan and protein O-glycan synthesis and lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members span GAG/proteoglycan biosynthesis and their congenital defects, O-mannosyl/fucosyl/glucosyl glycosylation (dystroglycan, Notch), and lysosomal GAG/glycolipid degradation (mucopolysaccharidoses), unlike neighbours focused on N-glycan, sialic acid, fucose or GPI metabolism.

name: Inhibition of integrin-matrix adhesion and Rho/Rac-driven actin assembly
rationale: Members restrain integrin signalling, focal adhesions, lamellipodia and actin bundles via Rho/Rac and IQGAP, with invadopodia, RPTP signalling and endothelial morphogenesis that the wound-migration and CDC42 neighbours lack.

qualifier: apoptotic cell clearance and amyloid-beta response
name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell clearance in neurodegeneration
rationale: Members concern microglial differentiation, activation and migration, engulfment of apoptotic cells (DAP12, PS exposure) and responses to amyloid-beta and neuronal injury, whereas neighbours centre on amyloid fibril formation and clearance.

name: NTF3-NTRK3 (TrkC) receptor signaling
rationale: All members describe NTF3 activation of NTRK3 and its RAS, PI3K and PLCG1 outputs, distinguishing it from NTRK2 (TrkB) and NGF-TRKA neighbours.

qualifier: germinal center, plasma cell and Tfh help
name: Germinal center B, plasma cell and Tfh differentiation
rationale: Members are B-cell, memory B and plasma-cell/immunoglobulin signatures with germinal-centre, plasma-cell and Tfh/ICOS differentiation, distinguishing it from naive B-cell, CD27/B-homeostasis and isotype-switching neighbours.

name: Hair follicle maturation, anagen cycling and nail development
rationale: Members regulate hair follicle development, maturation and anagen together with nail and epidermis morphogenesis, unlike neighbours on placode formation, teeth or keratinocyte differentiation.

core: Class I cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signaling
qualifier: EPO, TPO, growth hormone, prolactin and leptin
name: EPO/TPO, growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor signaling
rationale: Members are signalling by erythropoietin, thrombopoietin, growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and IL-11 receptors, distinguishing it from neighbours built on IL-2/IL-7 common-gamma, FLT3 and IL-6/LIF cytokines.

name: Positive Ras-to-RAF signaling via MRAS-SHOC2 and RIT/RIN
rationale: Members promote Ras signalling, RAF and RSK activation via MRAS-SHOC2 and RIT/RIN-p38, whereas neighbours concern ERK negative feedback, oncogenic BRAF/RAF1 mutants or SOS/IGF1R input.

name: Cellular response to toxic heavy metals, especially cadmium
rationale: Members are responses to cadmium, mercury, lead, selenium and cobalt with cadmium transport and detoxification, unlike zinc/copper/iron homeostasis and metallothionein neighbours.

name: Leukotriene and specialized pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis and catabolism
rationale: Members cover leukotriene, lipoxin and eoxin synthesis/catabolism and resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis, which neighbours on PAF, hepoxilins or leukotriene/prostanoid receptors lack.

qualifier: checkpoint kinase phosphorylation controlling p53 and Cdc25A stability
name: Checkpoint kinase phosphorylation control of p53 and Cdc25A stability
rationale: Members concern phosphorylation/dephosphorylation-dependent control of TP53 activity and degradation, COP1 and Cdc25A turnover, and p53-driven DNA repair genes, unlike neighbours on G2/M checkpoint progression or AKT targets.

qualifier: oocyte spindle positioning and polar body extrusion
name: Meiosis I entry and oocyte asymmetric spindle positioning
rationale: Members regulate meiosis I and the G2/MI transition, with female meiotic spindle assembly, positioning and polar body extrusion (plus a spermatogenesis set), unlike neighbours on cohesion, chiasmata, checkpoints or male recombination.

name: Glycogen synthesis, glycophagy and their storage disorders
rationale: Members are glycogen synthesis and glycophagy plus the storage diseases of GYS1/2, GBE1, GYG1, GAA and Lafora, while neighbours concern glycogenolysis, G6PC/SLC37A4 and glucokinase.

name: Skeletal muscle fiber formation, contraction and neuromuscular junction assembly
rationale: Members span myogenesis, sarcomere/thin-filament assembly, contraction, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex and NMJ assembly, distinguishing it from cardiac junction, calcineurin/atrophy and SRF-target neighbours.

qualifier: proteasome assembly and endogenous peptide loading
name: Proteasome assembly and endogenous MHC class I peptide loading
rationale: Members combine proteasome assembly with endogenous antigen processing, ER peptide transport and MHC I loading, whereas neighbours focus on cross-presentation of exogenous antigen and viral MHC/CD4 downregulation.

qualifier: alpha-2 adrenergic and adenosine receptors inhibiting secretion
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic/adenosine Gi/z signaling inhibiting insulin and catecholamine secretion
rationale: Members are adrenergic and adenosine receptor Gi/z signalling that inhibits adenylate cyclase and insulin/catecholamine secretion, unlike neighbours on cAMP/PKA turnover, smooth-muscle or cardiac adrenergic effects and muscarinic receptors.

name: PTK6 and ERBB signaling with ubiquitin-dependent receptor downregulation
rationale: Members cover PTK6 (BRK) signalling, ERBB/EGFR endocytic downregulation via ubiquitin and MVB sorting, and PTEN regulation, whereas neighbours centre on MET/HGF activation or ERBB adaptor and PI3K cascades.

name: High-energy phosphate transfer: creatine, nucleotide kinases, mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
rationale: Members are nucleoside mono/diphosphate phosphorylation, phosphocreatine metabolism and mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport with its effects on depolarization, distinguishing it from nucleoside transport and NAD neighbours.
